what_this_is: step 8's disclosure aggregation: which published answers depend on a restricted way. The owner's 2026-11-10 decision to keep the 120 s penalty was conditional on disclosing this gap rather than pricing it away
which_unit_a_disclosure_figure_may_use: structures_at_their_published_cell. The product answers for a cell, so that is what a household is told; the coordinate figures are model sensitivity. Pass 46 F2 found the first version's headline built on the coordinate unit -- 8,033 of 78,627 at T=10 -- where the published cell gives 7,276 of 80,067, and 23,330 structures carry a different flag between the two
what_is_still_not_the_shipped_answer: even the published-cell figure is the SOURCE grid's. The browser receives a WGS84 re-tiling and MapLibre places it in Mercator, each of which moves the lookup again (see s3-5-browser-path). And no flag plane is shipped at all, so every count here is a CANDIDATE disclosure rather than one any household can currently receive
the_statistic_this_does_not_compute: the SIGNED ERROR on restricted-route journeys. That needs walked journeys: this computes the denominator -- which answers are in the class -- and leaves the numerator empty. One walked journey found about 25 minutes against a published 13.5, so the known direction of the bias is OPTIMISTIC, but one journey is existence evidence and not a rate
